title_zh: 顺丰：摩托车上的快递帝国
title_en: Chinese Companies (17/20): SF Express, the Courier Empire That Started on a Motorcycle
note_en: 凡是 at the start of a sentence means "every single one who/that..." and marks a whole category: 凡是选择顺丰的客户，大多看重它速度快 "customers who choose SF Express mostly value its speed." It usually pairs with 都 (凡是…都… "anyone who... always..."); here 大多 "mostly" softens the claim. English just uses "anyone who" or "all those who" with a relative clause.
